slides.copy_text:
6 first projects (two weeks each)
Mess menu with ratings: one hard part is averaging ratings per dish
Lost-and-found board: photo upload
Laundry slot booker: no double booking
Shared notes: search
Attendance tracker: warning below 75%
Exam countdown: reminders

Before you call it done
Live link that opens on a phone
10 friends tried it
README with run steps
